svg.aria-label: Title screen: Prajakta Jadhav. Tonight's tech trivia, typed out one at a time: The @ key got the email job. It had nothing else to do. AI was named in 1956. They budgeted one summer to finish it. The first YouTube video is 19 seconds about elephants. Google was almost called BackRub. Imagine backrubbing symptoms. Bluetooth is named after a Viking king. He paired better. The first text message said Merry Christmas. No reply came. Press Start.
